title: Restore drill on a scratch VM (RTO ≤ 4 h)
caption: docs/mvp/runbooks/restore-drill.md and deploy/scripts/restore.sh. A scratch VM must never act as production.

steps.title: Provision a scratch VM without DNS
steps.body: As §3 of the deployment guide, never the production VM.

steps.title: Isolate before restoring
steps.body: `ufw default deny outgoing` + allow DNS, DHCP, mirrors, bucket; turn off every `velexis-*.timer` but egress-refresh; mask both workers via `/etc/systemd/system.control` links to /dev/null.

steps.title: Fetch and restore config
steps.body: `velexis-restore fetch daily/<date> /root/restore/set`; `velexis-restore config /root/restore/set --identity /root/restore/velexis-config.key`; point Amadeus URLs at `http://127.0.0.1:9`, SMTP at `smtp://127.0.0.1:2525`, empty Stripe keys, feature switches false; keep the scratch VM's own `backup.env` and set its `RCLONE_REMOTE` to a remote without `CHANGE_ME` (`offsite:scratch-no-bucket`), or `velexis-deploy` refuses the release.

steps.title: Restore data
steps.expect: Old database kept as `velexis_before_restore_<stamp>`; apps not started.

steps.title: Deploy and check
steps.expect: Figures (tenants, schemas, airports, last audit) match the MANIFEST; `/var/log/velexis/restore-drill-<date>.log` appended.

steps.title: Outbound evidence and cleanup
steps.body: Journal shows only `[UFW BLOCK]` for Amadeus/Stripe; `supplier_requests` counts unchanged. `shred -u` keys, destroy VM and disks, fill the drill log.
steps.expect: Drill row recorded with date, duration, result.
